en.text: He will come back in a few days.

original: トムは３日前に退院したよ。

en.text: Tom got out of the hospital three days ago.

original: トムは３日後にボストンに到着した。

en.text: Tom reached Boston three days later.
Tom arrived in Boston three days later.
